text:
Scope (lookback speed): user-facing dial from micro to macro that lengthens or shortens the moving averages of lows/highs used as entry/exit references. Lower scope → faster reaction, more signals in noisy sessions; higher scope → smoother envelope, fewer whipsaws. Usable retail range on the dial is roughly 0.5–10 with half-step granularity.

Only buy below / only sell above: when enabled, entries must print under the low-based reference and exits above the high-based reference, reducing trades taken through the middle of the range.

Buy buffer / sell buffer (%): optional offsets that require price to clear the reference by an extra margin before firing — widens the dead zone and reduces marginal fills hugging the envelope.
